name: One-Concept Labeled-Tree Saturation
statement: A class $H\subseteq\{0,1\}^X$ is labeled-tree-saturated when adjoining every missing concept strictly enlarges the collection of exact labeled complete binary trees shattered by $H$.
hypotheses: Finite Boolean concept class; exact trees are literal labeling maps and are not quotiented by tree automorphisms or query permutations.
